tenderSchedule.locationName: Bangalore International Airport Area Planning Authority

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Agency should not have been block listed by any organization in the State of Karnataka for any reason whatsoever
Each firm shall submit only one tender
The firm shall be responsible for all the costs with the preparation, submission and opening of tenders

The tender shall remain valid for a period not less than 90 days after the date of opening of tenders. A tender with a validity of less than 90 days shall be treated as non-responsive. If a tenderer withdraws his tender during the validity of the tender then EMD shall be forfeited
At any time prior to the date and time of submission of the tenders, the employer may issue any amendments to this tender document
